_comment: Water's ordered player guidance. Rows report durable personal/world facts; they never grant completion. Later rows remain implementation targets until their physical writer and player path are verified.

main.label: Meet Pell at First Shore.
main.how: Follow the beach to the swimming guide. Use {interact} to talk.

main.label: Swim between the lesson landings.
main.how: Cross the sheltered practice channel and step onto the far beach.

main.label: Restore Reedhaven's departure dock.
main.how: Reach Reedhaven and bring reed fiber and driftwood to the broken dock.

main.label: Win Tovin's Brine Steps trial.
main.how: Prepare your creatures, then challenge Tovin at the dock.

main.label: Free Shellwatch's residents and stop the pump.
main.how: Break Team Tether's hold on the landing before continuing to Tidal Cradle.

main.label: Resolve Aquaryn's trial.
main.how: Defeat or catch Aquaryn at Tidal Cradle. Either outcome opens the shared route to Salt Crown.

main.label: Chart Salt Crown's onward crossing.
main.how: Follow the stone-and-torch shoals on the sheltered crossing to Salt Crown. Rest on each dry centre, then use {interact} at 'Chart the Sluice Isle channel' beside the departure landing.

main.label: Disable Sluice Isle's two controls.
main.how: Find both pump controls to open the final crossing.

main.label: Confront Captain Nerissa inside the Veilfall.
main.how: Follow the sheltered shoals to Veilfall, resting on dry ground between swims. Climb to the waterfall and follow the hidden channels inward.

main.label: Release the Abyssal Guardian.
main.how: Reach the Heart Chamber and break the captive legendary's tether.

main.label: Restore the archipelago's currents.
main.how: Complete the release ceremony and witness the islands respond.

local.label: Learn Iona's optional Swim Saddle recipe.
local.how: Ask Iona at Tidal Cradle if you would like to ride a compatible companion. The saddle costs 8 reed fiber, 6 driftwood and 4 Reef Stone at a workbench.

local.label: Chart the Deep Watch return current.
local.how: Tidecoil is settled. Use {interact} at the chart table beside the Deep Watch landing, then take the lookout cache Orsen mentioned.

local.label: Swim to Lantern Cove's arch and back.
local.how: Follow the sheltered shallows west from First Shore to the rock arch at Lantern Cove, take the cache from the dry nook beneath it, then swim back and tell Pell at the First Shore landing.

local.label: Recover Adair's survey satchel from Gull Rest.
local.how: Take Reedhaven's sheltered crossing to Gull Rest and use {interact} at the satchel on the slope above the landing. Bring the observations to Surveyor Adair on your next Brine Steps passage.

local.label: Mine the Reef Stone in Tidal Cradle's shell nest.
local.how: Climb to the dry shell nest on Tidal Cradle's upper slope and mine its Reef Stone with a pickaxe. Return to Tracker Otto with a swimmer of your own, or once Aquaryn's trial is settled either way.

local.label: Copy the Drowned Garden vault's wall account.
local.how: Take the lawful route east from Salt Crown to the Drowned Garden's above-water vault and use {interact} at its wall. Bring the account back to Shrinekeeper Edda at Salt Crown.

local.label: Shelter the creature bed beside Lastlight.
local.how: Take the sheltered way beside Lastlight to the Veilfall landing camp and use {interact} to deliver 4 driftwood and 4 reed fiber. Then rest one companion in its creature bed, before or after facing Venn.
